items.title: Snowman Catching a Snowflake
items.alt: Tall snowman in a lime green cap and navy scarf holding a closed burgundy umbrella and reaching toward one snowflake.
items.description: The long carrot nose and raised twig hand point toward the flake while the folded umbrella rests at the opposite side.

items.title: Snowman Playing a Red Drum
items.alt: Round snowman wearing a green tassel cap and gold scarf playing a red drum with two wooden mallets.
items.description: The drum sits on a shoulder strap, with one mallet lifted and the other poised over its cream drumhead.

items.title: Snowman Playing a Violin
items.alt: Slender snowman in a burgundy beret and blue scarf playing a small brown violin with its eyes closed.
items.description: A diagonal bow crosses the strings while one branch hand supports the instrument beneath the snowman's chin.

items.title: Snowman Balancing on a Snowboard
items.alt: Small snowman in a teal helmet and red scarf balancing on an orange snowboard with both twig arms spread.
items.description: Two rounded snow feet rest on the curved board while the open smile and trailing scarf suggest motion.

items.title: Snowman Ice Fishing
items.alt: Snowman in a yellow patched cap and green scarf seated on a wooden stool, fishing through a small blue ice hole.
items.description: Green mittens hold a short rod whose line drops into the ring of ice beside the stool.

items.title: Snowman Studying a Spare Carrot
items.alt: Surprised snowman in a navy cap and red vest holding a leafy carrot and looking at it with raised eyebrows.
items.description: The large spare carrot contrasts with the tiny orange nose on the wide-eyed face.
